name: risky-parts
description: When a permission dialog opens for a Bash command, shows which parts of the command are risky, in red: above the dialog, in a side pane, and in the tmux status line or a desktop notification.

modelFallback.title: Ask a model when no pattern matches
modelFallback.description: When none of the risky-command patterns match a command awaiting approval, ask a small model which part is risky.

model.title: Fallback model
model.description: The model asked when no pattern matches: an alias such as haiku, or a full model id.

extraPatterns.title: Extra patterns
extraPatterns.description: More regular expressions to treat as risky, separated by " ;; " (for example: terraform\s+apply ;; \bprod-db\b).

noticeCommand.title: Command when a dialog opens
noticeCommand.description: A shell command run when a permission dialog opens for a Bash command with risky parts. Default: the bundled script (the tmux status line in red; a desktop notification where the pane could not open). Empty: none. It gets $RISKY_PARTS_TEXT, $RISKY_PARTS_PANE (1 if the pane is showing), $RISKY_PARTS_ID and $RISKY_PARTS_ROOT.

noticeClearCommand.title: Command when the dialog is answered
noticeClearCommand.description: A shell command run once that dialog is answered or times out, to take the notice back.
